name: Gossip Girl ~Celeb na Kare no Yuuwaku~
original_name: ゴシップガール～セレブな彼の誘惑～
source: A dating sim set in the Gossip Girl universe. The main character is a woman who recently moved to New York and joined the Constance Billiard School for Girls. She will become acquitanced with a bunch of young men and women, with cameos of characters from the original series.
translation: 一款以《绯闻女孩》世界观为背景的恋爱模拟游戏。主人公是一名刚搬到纽约的女性，进入康斯坦斯比拉德女子学校就读。她将结识一群年轻男女，原剧角色也会客串登场。
